name: ats-jobs-mcp
description: Open job postings from Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby public job boards in one unified schema.
long_description: Live access to open job postings from any company hiring through Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby, read from the platforms' official public no-auth job-board APIs. Multi-company job search, full board listings, job details and ATS detection, with salary ranges when the employer publishes them. No API key needed.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs across up to 20 companies that hire via Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby.

tools.name: list_company_jobs
tools.description: List all open jobs of one company (compact: no descriptions), newest first, plus department counts.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job posting, including the complete description as plain text.

tools.name: detect_ats
tools.description: Find which ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) a company uses and its board slug.
